scope: CodecDelay and signed BlockGroup padding; normative whole-block intervals including lacing, global-delay intersection, compressed presentation seeks and empty output. Expected intervals are selected by an independent per-sample mask from unchanged unpadded PCM; codec DSP has separate conformance suites. Timestamp gap scheduling and arbitrary SeekPreRoll are not established.
